top_signals.title: Shipping Traffic Is Up Despite War in Iran, Says FreightWaves CEO
top_signals.summary: Craig Fuller, CEO of FreightWaves, sees stronger trucking, rail and container volumes despite higher shipping and insurance costs because of the war in Iran. He also talks about a new shipping route that is being used to get through the Arctic to avoid the Strait of Hormuz. Fuller speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
